svg.text: Re-imagined rather than ported; iOS can follow it

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: later. The top says who this phone is: avatar, name,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: and address (tap to copy). Four actions sit under it,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: as on a contact card.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: nearby nodes learn: answering identity requests, the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: two schedules, and location. Each row states its

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: current value, so the page needs no footers.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif
